envelope.rule: D-082: cells water at the record low (3 lowest E3 bins) are water at every level

level_datum.source: bins on NAVD 88 minus 1300.0 m (Amendment 16 item 5)
level_datum.meaning: added to the DAHITI-scale bin centres (working datum: DAHITI, D-070)

seeds.sea: largest open-water component of the arm (5 km, >= 80%), inside the domain less its rim; it may lie inside the stage-2 cover (observed there)
seeds.land: observed cells > 2 km from near-maximum water (D-067 construction), outside zone and rim

ponds: OpenStreetMap salt ponds + 120 m: unknown (counts zeroed, outside state unknown)
product: USGS 3DEP 1/3 arc-second, mean over each 60 m cell (positive-control substitute, Amendment 16 item 7)
